in_hebrew.name: Claretta
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Clear, bright, shining
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Claretta הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word 'clarus', meaning 'clear, bright, shining'. The name Claretta was popular among the early Christians and was given to babies born during the Christmas season, symbolizing the light of Christ.
